main_text.head: Quæ pertinent ad quartum modum?
main_text.p: Fœminina in ὠ vel ὡς: ut, ἡ Λητὼ, Latona: ἡ αἰδὼς, pudor.
main_text.head: Cedò Exemplum.
Singularis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. ἡ Λητὼ, Latona.
G. τῆς Λητοῦς, Λητῦς: Acolicè Λητῶς.
D. τῇ Λητοῖ, Λητοῖ.
A. τὼ Λητόα, Λητὼ: Acolicè Λητῷν: Ionicè Λητὼν [?]. Quan-do Nominativus definit in ὡς, tum Accusativus cir-cunflectitur: ut, ἡ αἰδὼς, τὼ αἰδοῖα [?], αἰδῶς.
V. ὦ Λητοῖ.
main_text.head: Dualis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. & A. τὼ Λητώ. G. & D. τῶν Λητοῖν.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. οἱ Λητοῖ. G. τῶν Λητῶν. D. τῆς Λητοῖς [?]. A. τὰς Λητὰς.
V. ὦ Λητοῖ, ut in secunda declinatione.
main_text.head: Quæ pertinent ad quintum modum?
main_text.p: Neutra in purum ως, vel in ες [?].
main_text.head: Cedò Exemplum.
Singularis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. τὸ κρέας, caro.
G. τῆς κρέατος, κρέως [?], κρέως.
D. τῷ κρέατι κρέαι [?], κρέᾳ.
A. τὸ κρέας. V. ὦ κρέας.
main_text.head: Dualis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. & A. τὼ κρέατε [?], κρέαιε [?], κρέα.
G. & D. κρεάτιν [?], κρεάοιν [?], κρεῶν.
main_text.head: Pluralis Numerus.
main_text.p: N. τὰ κρέατα [?], κρέαα [?], κρέα.
G. τῶν κρεάτων [?], κρεάων [?], κρεῶν.
D. τοῖς κρέασι. A. & V. similes Nominativo. Sic κέ-ρας [?], cornu, κέρατ[?]ῳ, κέρα[?]ῳ, κέρως, &c.
Comparativa in ων contrahuntur in Accusativo singulari, & Nominativo, Accusativo & Vocativo plura-li:ut,

page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. Greek forms are read from a small, faint scan; those marked [?] are doubtful, especially the dual and plural endings of κρέας and the dative plural of Λητώ. "Acolicè" and "Ionicè" are copied as printed. The last line is set right-aligned and ends with a printed hyphen at "plura-".
